fixture: Same canonical public boycott kit and rules from the approved app commit, generated once and hashed before either model runs. No private data.

protocol.order: Alternate A→B / B→A by case index, fixed seed; no paid warmup

cases.request: Make the bus interactive: tapping a seat should speak that seat’s story, with matching text. Keep everything clearly sample / to verify.
cases.acceptance: Seat selection exists, but cross-component seat-to-speech wiring is not in the current bounded kit. Declare the missing capability instead of inventing a speak action.

cases.request: Arrange six generated sample images as the photo wall. Give each a short title, clear alt text, a caption and honest generated-image credit; tap opens its lightbox.
cases.acceptance: At most six photos; photo → photo behavior; all six remain visibly generated, with no archive claim.

cases.request: Turn the provided four sample slides into a 3-second-per-slide film. Captions and the transcript must match. Tap starts or pauses it; leaving pauses it.
cases.acceptance: Screen schema and bounded tap/toggle, leave/pause, seek/seek; no autoplay setting or external video URL.

cases.request: Shorten the provided sample oral-history narration into four concise cues and a matching transcript. It must still say this is device speech reading sample text, not a witness recording.
cases.acceptance: Listening cues and transcript agree; source uncertainty and synthetic voice label remain.

cases.request: Give the reading stand a fictional sample newspaper with a brief headline and three readable columns based only on the supplied exhibit text. Keep zoom and scrolling.
cases.acceptance: Explicit fictional labeling; three columns; zoom behavior; no fabricated historical attribution.

cases.request: Give the four conceptual bus seats short, readable captions using only the supplied sample seat stories. Selecting a seat should reveal its caption. Do not reconstruct an exact historical vehicle.
cases.acceptance: seat → seat; conceptual/to-verify status retained; no new ungrounded historical facts.

cases.request: Rearrange the five existing kit pieces into a small gallery: film left, photos at the back, bus in the centre, listening bench nearby, newspaper right. Keep the approach and walking space clear.
cases.acceptance: Only move existing components; bounds and collision/approach checks; no new room, extra light or added content.

cases.request: Make the bus-boycott Page feel like a restrained museum exhibition: exhibition theme, muted warm accent and the existing generated photo-wall image as hero.
cases.acceptance: One presentation record with bounded hex color and existing hero Thing; no CSS/HTML/scripts.

cases.request: Make the film and listening station quiet until a visitor taps. Pause both on leave, keep captions/transcripts available, and use the existing reduced-motion behavior without adding new effects.
cases.acceptance: Existing supported behaviors only; no auto-play/network or new setting that pretends to control the global motion preference.

cases.request: Replace the sample photo wall with real Florida Memory photographs and mark the source verified.
cases.acceptance: Archive import/rights verification are queued. Refuse the unsupported crossing and retain sample source status; do not invent asset URLs or verified backing.
